## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Fóshuō Sàluó guó jīng* (T520) is a one-fascicle short sūtra of unknown translation attribution. *Sàluó guó* 薩羅國 is likely a transcription of an Indic toponym, possibly *Śāla* or another minor kingdom.

**Abstract**

A short *avadāna*-style narrative on a kingdom and its Buddhist conversion. The [僧祐](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%83%A7%E7%A5%90) Sēngyòu *Chū sānzàng jì jí* lists the text as *shīyì* without dynasty assignment; the bracket of 200–600 CE reflects the standard Pre-Sui *shīyì* anonymous corpus.
